result.instructions: Tools for Productive.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects are over budget this month?"; "Log 90 minutes on the homepage redesign task for today."; "Show the open tasks assigned to me in the Website project.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Productive.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run productiveio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run productiveio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run productiveio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. productiveio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.description: List projects in the organization, with filters (for example name or project_type_id), sorting and side-loading. Productive API: GET /projects.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -updated_at.

include.description: Comma-separated related resources to side-load, e.g. project,assignee.

assignee_id.description: Assign the task to this person.
